description: Renovate for EventHub. Needs the Renovate GitHub App installed on the repository. Automerge (platformAutomerge) relies on branch protection for main with required status checks: without it GitHub merges immediately. See EventHub/docs/HANDOFF.md.

customManagers.description: Keep the ruff version installed by the backend CI job in step with the ruff pre-commit hook

packageRules.description: Frontend: keep the caret ranges from package.json (also for devDependencies, overriding :pinDevDependencies) and let the lock file carry the exact versions
Backend: pins live in requirements*.lock, ranges in requirements*.txt
Generic rules come first: in Renovate the LAST matching rule wins, so the specific rules below (groups, ruff) can override them. Automerge low-risk updates once the required checks pass
Major updates wait for approval on the Dependency Dashboard and are never merged automatically
Dev-only npm dependencies use the chore type
Angular, its tooling and its runtime pieces move together
Angular 21 supports TypeScript >=5.9 <6.1 (peer range of @angular/compiler-cli). Revisit together with the next Angular major.

requirements*.lock pins every transitive package. The pip-compile manager cannot read the headers written by `uv pip compile --python-platform ...` (checked against the Renovate source: it rejects -o, --python-platform and space-separated option values), so the locks are updated as plain pins (pip resolves anything new at install time; CI builds the images and runs the tests). Everything that has no group of its own goes into one weekly PR instead of one PR per transitive package.
Django, DRF and Channels: framework releases are tested together (later rules win, so this overrides the catch-all python group)
ruff (CI pin and pre-commit hook) updates as one PR; formatter changes need a human look, so no automerge
All GitHub Actions in one PR, pinned by digest with the tag kept as a comment
pre-commit hook revisions are frozen SHAs (# frozen: vX.Y.Z), which Renovate keeps; do not re-pin
